comparison.objective: Crossfade two audio faders without dead air or excessive overlap; candidate tunes and locks a physical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated opposite linear fader motion versus recessed-key insertion, fine collar rotation, counterholding and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Trajectory constraints and final fader positions versus repeatable non-bottoming carriage stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both involve adjustment and coordinated control, but one tests simultaneous signal-control motion while the other tests mechanical commissioning from dynamic response. Candidate rubric lacks numeric rebound, overload and drift limits.
